context_for_next_testing_agent: ENZI invite system fully tested. Backend endpoints: POST /api/lumi/invite/send (send email invitations), GET /api/lumi/invite/link (generate shareable link), GET /api/lumi/invite/validate/<token> (validate token), POST /api/lumi/invite/register (register via invite), GET /api/lumi/domain/colleagues (company discovery). Frontend: Portal shows ENZI card, login shows 'Sign in to ENZI', dashboard has 'Invite to ENZI' CTA, invite modal has Email/Share Link/History tabs. Note: Resend API is in testing mode so email_sent may be false for non-owner emails.
